reasons.label: Match result
reasons.text: PSV are favoured at 50%, against 28% for Club Brugge KV and 22% for the draw. Elo separates them by only 21 points, so the edge is small. Over the last five: PSV 0.8 points per game, Club Brugge KV 1.4. They average 0.7 points per game at home this season.

reasons.label: Goals
reasons.text: The model expects 3.96 goals, which puts it over 2.5 at 76%. Across their last five, PSV and Club Brugge KV have scored 1.6 and conceded 2.0 a game between them. Club Brugge KV are the sharper of the two in front of goal right now, not PSV.

reasons.label: Self-correction
reasons.text: Adjusted from this competition's own record: goals were predicted 3.11 against 3.63 actual across 182 settled forecasts, so the rate is nudged up 16.9% to stop the model leaning under.

limitations: Only 3 league matches of this season behind the weaker-evidenced side, so form leans on last season.
